meta.title: System configuration and topology — structural connections
meta.subtitle: Client/server component placement and RouteMesh/ClientServer connections (Store/evidence in the resource table)

cards.title: Channel names (verbatim)
items: Solid RouteMesh edges are for object routing — on the courier side `deliverydispatch.courier` (D/CS → CourierActorNode replicas), on the customer side `deliverydispatch.customer` (Tracking → CustomerGateway).
The dashed ClientServer channels are deliverydispatch.dispatch (CourierActorNode → Dispatch) and deliverydispatch.tracking (Dispatch → Tracking).
The ClientServer arrows show the direction of requests. The RouteMesh arrows show peer connections.
The play node is the Client that calls the api node, which is the Server on the ZLink ClientServer Channel.

cards.title: Roles and boundaries
items: Dispatch provides the HTTP edge and the dispatch worker. CourierSession/CustomerGateway receive STREAMs and bind the current session to each Actor. CourierActorNode replicas are eligible object servers offering the same Actor type and Entry Spot (green). Tracking records status events and sends them to the Customer Actor.
The number of servers and the actor owner are not fixed by Application configuration. The Location Store provides current authority and the Framework selects the target.
